quest.title: Someday, We All Must Walk Alone
quest.description: Your little saurian companion seems to have something to tell you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, where'd you get this Kamera from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you sneak up on someone and... No way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oho! Isn't that the "Mighty Meaty Fireball"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, back in the Children of Echoes, wasn't there this guy who wanted to be a director, but used his Kamera the wrong way round... Ah! Is that where you got your Kamera?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Ehrr... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You wanna take a picture with us, right? Hehe, Paimon gets you!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... we've been adventuring for so long, but haven't taken any pictures together! Now that the little one's curse has been lifted, he can finally grow up big and strong!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon isn't sure how long it takes for Tepetlisaurs to grow up... If {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} turns into an adult tomorrow, we won't get to see him as a baby anymore!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, hehe, let's take that picture!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Master Photographer Paimon's set everything up, this should be just right! And the Kamera's definitely facing us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everyone, say "Mighty Meaty Fireball" in three, two, one!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Mighty Meaty Fireball"!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Raaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #There we go. Wow, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is really striking an impressive pose!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} takes one of the photographs, turns around, and carefully tucks it away beneath the hard shell on his back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But why did {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} suddenly want to take a picture?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Groooah...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wroooh...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wroooh... Roooah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What's wrong, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Are you feeling unwell? Hmm... He doesn't look very happy...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Raaawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You want to set off on your own adventure...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Your... own adventure? Don't you wanna keep traveling with us? Uh oh, did Paimon do something to make you mad...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon won't call you greedy again! Please, d—don't leave us!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wroooh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sniff* P—Paimon knows... Everyone's gotta grow up someday... and *sob* everyone has places they wanna go...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... Paimon doesn't want to say goodbye... Not all of a sudden like this...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't cry. We'll meet again someday...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Really? Wh—When we need help in the future, you'd better come find us right away, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And... if you run into trouble on your adventures, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you can come find us then too! Don't try to act tough!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Don't eat too much, and don't pick fights you can't win. Paimon said not to eat too much, but you should still eat plenty of meat stew...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—A—And...! Th—The most important thing of all... is that you should...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Grow up happy and healthy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Happy and healthy and big! Till you're the size of at least three mountains!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yup! Th—That's the spirit! *sob* D—Don't you dare forget about us!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: In the tranquil serenity of the forest, you share a parting plate of Blazed Meat Stew. Thereafter, you tidy away your pop-up campsite.\nYou prepare some mementos for your little friend, who is about to set off on his own journey. You can't help but reminisce about your adventures together — the Yumkasaurus blocking the way in a cave, the Blubberbeast by the shore, and all the curious characters you've met along the way...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text:
Lastly... you linger briefly on the one who communicates in strange golden script...
As Paimon puts it, "He was just using us! He never even showed his face."
It makes you think back to the complex mix of emotions reflected in the eyes of your young saurian companion at the foot of the Sacred Mountain.
...Although he is still small, he will surely grow up to become a mighty saurian indeed.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: In the very, very end, he presses his horn against Paimon's forehead, before nuzzling tenderly at your outstretched palm.\nThen, after a long pause, in which he seems to be mustering up the courage...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The young saurian resolutely turns around and plods off into the distance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, Paimon sorta remembers...

talks.objective: Return to where you first met your saurian companion
Return to where you first met your saurian companion

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? What's wrong, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Is there something you wanna tell us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe he's tired, we should take a break... Hmm, Paimon has an idea, why don't we relax at the place where we first met?
